'''2009 Bespin Regionals Tyler Vastag LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tyler Vastag]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Username:''' tvas27
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
